summary_for_agent: Customer reports a failed UPI debit of ₹1,800 on 2026-10-27 that remains debited but not credited; they are requesting a refund and RBI-mandated compensation. The transaction is 3 days past the T+1 RBI TAT with ₹300 compensation due, and the auto-refund/auto-compensation limits (₹5,000 / ₹1,000) are within scope.
